cohort_sizing: Controlled synthetic 5/50/250 cohorts. The median label is the middle scenario, not a measured real-user median.

methodology.paint: Actual /api/data fetch start to two animation frames after the fixture title is rendered; a frame boundary proxy, not compositor presentation time.
methodology.updateTrigger: nextRefreshPoll(): the production background-poll path, including its focus/open-choice deferrals; no manual refresh bypass.
methodology.browserProfile: One fresh owned profile per invocation. Each cohort gets one new-document load per invocation; later cohorts share cache with earlier cohorts. Repeat invocations for independent profiles, not independent cold-cache cohorts.
methodology.observers: Main-window fetch/timer/WebSocket wrappers, primitive MutationObserver counts and long-task observer; identical instrumentation required for comparisons.
methodology.sockets: WebSocket instances only; TCP/socket descriptors are unavailable.
methodology.retention: Removed node observations and CDP DOM counters are trends, not proof of retained detached-node memory.
methodology.statePaint: Empty/unavailable have no unique sequence marker in production DOM; update-to-paint unavailable.

budget_policy.timing: Same browser, machine, driver and cohort order only. Median times 1.5 plus 50ms allows runner noise; cross-machine timings are not compared to these absolute limits.
budget_policy.core_html: At most 25% growth over the recorded core HTML; separately account for the optional terminal packaging decision before migration.
budget_policy.resource_counts: Main-window timers, WebSockets and listener counts must settle after navigation; CDP raw node growth alone is not a retained-memory proof. EventSource/TCP/detached-node coverage remains unavailable here and needs separate behavioral transport tests.

scope_limits: Each run starts a fresh owned browser profile; later cohorts load new documents in that same profile and may share browser/font caches.
Two animation frames after the rendered marker is a frame-boundary proxy, not compositor presentation.
Native goal typing, caret and focus were measured; correction undo, IME and open-select behavior remain required browser checks in their migration issues.
Flat synthetic session cohorts do not model every worker/history/reading shape; those remain in the ownership and parity inventory.
